title: Pair task singular directions with acquired numerical accuracy rather than assuming a free precision oracle
statement: For the unrestricted residual ball ||R||_2<=rho and a fixed multiset of unit-input Euclidean error budgets eta_i, exact deterministic minimax task error is sum_{i<=k}min(eta_(i),rho)*sigma_i(M)+rho*sum_{i>k}sigma_i(M). A checked diagonal-dominant Jacobi source supplies a separate concrete accuracy/cost menu.

requires: Declared deterministic bounded-input/adversarial-error residual-ball contract; sorted fixed error menu. The software cost interface additionally requires actual rational A with positive row dominance mu and Jacobi alpha<1.

assumptions: Not a minimax theorem for every additional historical/physical constraint or randomized class. Field/arithmetic/sampling and failed-request costs remain. The finite menu optimizer is not global optimality over all experiments.
costs: Each query returns m scalars. Local relation discovery can cost a combinatorial support search. The reported two tasks use two queries each and leave 16 response parameters unresolved; input/output rationals reach 170/200 bits. Initialization costs 4,645 Fraction operations; generic task plans 14,913/18,147; a zero-query specialization reduces 16,129 to 76 operations. These are source-reported software controls, not total-runtime or architecture-superiority evidence. The source reports32calls/1024returned coordinates per source plus earlier support acquisition, failed repeated calls, rational proof work and retained histories. Its costed precision plan uses18 versus2520Jacobi sweeps and3616 versus474003Fraction calls; these are reported software costs, not hardware/time superiority. A dense growing history is retained; no fixed-width update theorem.
contract.units: Source-local operator/input/output units are preserved. Query and arithmetic counts are distinct; perturbation parameters, spectral windows and hbar/time conventions are explicitly stated by the governing proof.
contract.obstruction: Acquire informative structure without reaching full input span on substantial new tasks, while retaining honest enclosures, ambiguity witnesses and equally informed source-code/tomography controls. The old exact-rational theorem remains valid; source changes/refits require fresh calibration. No general nonlinear mechanism discovery, physical calibration or exclusive program-search advantage is established.

body: For the upper bound query task right singular directions using the smallest eta for the largest singular values. For the zero-transcript lower bound, sort actual query accuracies, use their nested span projectors P_i and D=rho*I-sum_i(eta_(i+1)-eta_(i))*P_i. Indistinguishable ±U*D obey each query error budget; Ky Fan trace bounds give the matching error. Separately, exact residuals of Ay=f enclose ||Hf-y||_infinity by ||f-Ay||_infinity/mu. Quantized Jacobi yields alpha^t/mu+2^(-p-1)/(1-alpha), which must be converted to the declared query norm before planning. This obtains a software promise without claiming a calibrated unknown physical instrument.
